source.title: A biohybrid synapse with neurotransmitter-mediated plasticity

material: PEDOT:PSS (PH1000) organic neuromorphic device (electrochemical transistor) coupled with PC-12 cells in PDMS microfluidic channel

formulation.evidence: PEDOT:PSS (Hereaus, Clevios PH 1000) aqueous solution was prepared by adding 6 vol.% ethylene glycol (Sigma-Aldrich) to increase the PEDOT:PSS conductivity
0.1 vol.% dodecylbenzene sulfonic acid (Sigma-Aldrich) as a surfactant
1 vol.% (3-glycidyloxypropyl)trimethoxysilane (Sigma-Aldrich) as a crosslinking agent to improve mechanical stability

processing.evidence: PEDOT:PSS solution was spun on the wafer die at 1,000 r.p.m. for 2min and baked at 120 °C for 20min.
PEDOT:PSS solution was spun on the wafer die at 1,000 r.p.m. for 2min and baked at 120 °C for 20min.

The wafer dies were gently rinsed in deionized water to eliminate residual soap and were subsequently dried at 120 °C for 5min.

description.value: synaptic plasticity behavior from dopamine oxidation retained
description.evidence: The efficiency of the device remains unaltered since synaptic plasticity behavior from dopamine oxidation is retained following extended exposure to the cell culture media.

duration_days.evidence: We found that the long-term viability of cells extends to at least 24h (Extended Data Fig. 6), confirming the stability of the biohybrid synapse.

stability.conditions: synaptic plasticity after extended exposure to cell culture media, 24 h after cell plating

other_outcomes.evidence: constitutes the biohybrid synaptic cleft with an average spacing of 100nm and minimum distance points of 5–10nm
other_outcomes.name: cell-electrode cleft average spacing

other_outcomes.evidence: resulting in a permanent decrease of the postsynaptic conductance Gpost (Fig. 3a) of 8.4±2.8μS per pulse
other_outcomes.name: long-term conditioning ΔGpost per pulse after 2 h incubation

other_outcomes.evidence: resulting in a 40% larger long-term conditioning ΔGpost (11.8±4μS, CDA of ~15–20μM) in response to postsynaptic pulses
other_outcomes.name: long-term conditioning ΔGpost after 4 h incubation

other_outcomes.evidence: is increased (120mM KCl), the postsynaptic voltage pulses elicit long-term conditioning of the device of ΔGpost of 5.4±0.8μS per pulse
other_outcomes.name: long-term conditioning ΔGpost per pulse with 120 mM KCl stimulation

notes: PEDOT:PSS channel and gate on Si/SiO2 with Ti/Au interconnects, Parylene-C insulation; measured in DMEM cell culture media at 37 °C under microfluidic flow. Cells seeded at 770,000 or 1,540,000 cells cm-2 in channels.
